verdict.rationale: Typesense is driven through a public API: its docs state that the complete API surface is available in the open-source server, there is an API reference section (e.g. /docs/latest/api/curation), Cloud plans list Full API Access, and a community user independently describes the REST interface. The OpenAPI probe returned 404, but that only shows no spec at those paths and does not contradict the documented API. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe 404 at standard paths), in-depth API reference content shown in the pack beyond section titles.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
